messages:
oncall-bot: 🔔 Incident alert — elevated 5xx on dedicated pool dp-olive-03 (region: us-west-2). 5xx rate 9.2% over 2m. Pager: Maria G
Maria G: ack, joining bridge now. tagging ops in case we need isolation.
Ajay P: pulling tail of model server logs for dp-olive-03. seeing increased OOM / tokenization errors around 15:42 UTC. attaching snippet.
Ajay P: ```2026-03-17T15:42:13Z model_worker[pid=2145]: ERROR allocate failed: cuda out of memory
2026-03-17T15:42:14Z kvcache: eviction triggered for tenant=olive-suite
```
Sasha L: Is olive-suite the only tenant spiking? any noisy tenants?
Eli C: Checking metrics — olive-suite spike correlates with a sudden queue burst on route /v1/chat/generate (p95 latency up x4). No other tenants in pool showing same error rate.
Taylor-CS: FYI Acme / Olive Suite on-calls are already opening a ticket. they report increased latency & 5xx in last 10m. Asking for ETA and if we will provide credits.
Maria G: initial containment plan: (1) throttle olive-suite to 60% QPS, (2) move other tenants off dp-olive-03 to spare pool dp-olive-01, (3) restart 2 problematic workers. can we do (2) without customer downtime?
Ajay P: yes for other tenants. I'll run a drain: ```rbac: migrate-tenants --from dp-olive-03 --to dp-olive-01 --exclude tenant=olive-suite --grace=30s```
Eli C: I'll kick a rolling restart on the 2 workers hitting OOMs after migration completes. watch for cold-start latency.
Maria G: oncall-bot, escalate to infra if migration fails.
oncall-bot: Escalation rule in place — infra team will be paged at 15:50 UTC if runbook step fails.
Sasha L: quick ask — what was root cause hypothesis? noisy tenant or memory leak?
Ajay P: early signal points at a large prompt/embedding batch from olive-suite that caused KVcache blowup + memory pressure. Not seeing leak across rest of pool.
Taylor-CS: Acme wants a short customer note: timeline, what we did, mitigation, and next steps (RCA + any credits). can we prep a 1-paragraph update for them?
Maria G: drafting short customer note in thread: "We observed elevated errors caused by an unusually large burst from Olive Suite. We throttled traffic, migrated tenants to another pool to protect service, and restarted affected workers. Full RCA + remediation plan to follow." Thoughts?
Sasha L: add estimated affected window: 15:38–15:47 UTC and mention we will offer a one-time credit pending RCA severity.
Eli C: agreed. I'll capture metrics and attach p95/p99 graphs for that window.
Ajay P: mitigation completed: migration finished at 15:44:22, restarts done by 15:45:10. 5xx rate back under 0.5% at 15:46:00. confirming stable.
Maria G: great — moving this to post-incident work: (A) RCA draft, (B) Exec blurb for Sales/CS, (C) decide credit qty. volunteers?
Taylor-CS: I can draft the customer-facing comms and coordinate credit ask with finance.
Sasha L: I'll own the RCA draft. will include sequence, root cause (large-batch request + cache eviction), mitigations, and long-term fixes: per-tenant burst throttles + KVcache caps + automated expensive-request detection.
Maria G: assign follow-ups in our tracker, ping me when drafts are ready for review. Thank you team. :tada:
